# Introduction

Script for evaluation of ClustoCell's Performance in finding novel biology, validation in other dataset(s).

# Function Defintion

We first define some helper functions.

```{r}

# Personalized Theme function

styled_theme <- function(
  style = c("academic", "minimal", "modern", "dark", "classic", "void"),
  border_mode = c("default", "all", "none"),
  title_align = c("center", "left", "right"),
  legends_to_drop = NULL,
  axes_title_drop = FALSE,
  legend_position = c("default", "top", "bottom", "left", "right", "inside"),
  axis_title_face = c("regular", "bold"),
  x_axis_text_angle = 45,
  x_axis_text_y = -0.3,
  remove_margin = c("none", "bottom", "all", "top", "left", "right")
) {
  style <- match.arg(style)
  border_mode <- match.arg(border_mode)
  title_align <- match.arg(title_align)
  legend_position <- match.arg(legend_position)
  axis_title_face <- match.arg(axis_title_face)
  remove_margin <- match.arg(remove_margin)

  base_font <- "Helvetica"
  align_map <- c(left = 0, center = 0.5, right = 1)
  hjust_val <- align_map[title_align]
  thin_size <- 0.3  

  # Decide axis title face
  axis_face_val <- ifelse(axis_title_face == "bold", "bold", "plain")

  # Base theme selection
  if (style == "void") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),  
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "academic") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = hjust_val, color = "grey30"),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1, color = "grey40"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val, size = 13),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "minimal") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic")
      )
  } else if (style == "modern") {
    theme_out <- theme_light(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "dark") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey30", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "white", hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey80", hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "white", face = axis_face_val),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "white", face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "white", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "classic") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  }

  # Apply border mode
  if (border_mode == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = thin_size))
  } else if (border_mode == "none") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
  }

  # Drop axes titles if requested
  if (axes_title_drop) {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }

  # Override x-axis text angle and vertical position
  theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = x_axis_text_angle,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = x_axis_text_y)
    )
  )

  # Handle margin removal
  if (remove_margin == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "top") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "bottom") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(b = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "left") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(l = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "right") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(r = 0))
  }
  # if "none", do nothing

  # Legend positioning override
  if (legend_position != "default") {
    if (legend_position == "inside") {
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
        legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
        legend.direction = "vertical"
      )
    } else {
      horiz <- legend_position %in% c("top", "bottom")
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = legend_position,
        legend.direction = if (horiz) "horizontal" else "vertical"
      )
    }
  }

  # Return theme + guides if needed
  if (!is.null(legends_to_drop)) {
    drop_list <- lapply(legends_to_drop, function(x) "none")
    names(drop_list) <- legends_to_drop
    return(list(theme_out, guides(.list = drop_list)))
  } else {
    return(theme_out)
  }
}

# Label plot
label_plt <- function(label = "Label", size = 1) {
  ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    # Draw a single vertical bar
    geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "lightgrey", color = "black") +
    # Add vertical text (angle=90)
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0.5, label = label, size = size,
             angle = 90, size = 6, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5) +
    # Remove all extra space
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +             # no axes, ticks, labels
    theme(
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),      # remove outside margins
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),         # remove panel padding
        plot.background = element_blank(),     # no background
        panel.background = element_blank()
    )
}

# Box plot with stats

make_facet_boxplot_with_stats <- function(
    df,
    x = "group",
    y = "value",
    fill = NULL,
    palette = NULL,
    facet.by = NULL,
    scales = "free_y",
    facet.nrow = NULL,       
    facet.ncol = NULL,      
    alpha = 0.8,
    xlab = NULL,
    ylab = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL,
    tag = NULL,
    jitter.width = 0.15,
    jitter.size = 0.35,
    jitter.alpha = 0.6,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    p.adjust.method = "none",
    hide.ns = FALSE,
    base_size = 10
) {

  library(dplyr)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggplot2)

  # ----------------------------
  # 1. Statistical test per facet
  # ----------------------------
  stat.test <- df %>%
    group_by(!!sym(facet.by)) %>%
    rstatix::wilcox_test(as.formula(paste(y, "~", x))) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = p.adjust.method) %>%
    add_significance()

  # Add xy positions (critical for facetted layout)
  stat.test <- stat.test %>% add_xy_position(x = x)

  # ----------------------------
  # 2. Build ggpubr boxplot
  # ----------------------------
  p <- ggpubr::ggboxplot(
    df,
    x = x,
    y = y,
    fill = fill,
    alpha = alpha,
    palette = palette,
    facet.by = facet.by,
    scales = scales,
    nrow = facet.nrow,  
    ncol = facet.ncol,   
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = jitter.width,
      size = jitter.size,
      alpha = jitter.alpha
    ) +
    labs(
      x = xlab,
      y = ylab,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      tag = tag
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7),
      text = element_text(size = 6),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 5.5),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 5),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  # ----------------------------------
  # 3. Add p-value stars to the plot
  # ----------------------------------
  p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    hide.ns = hide.ns,
    size = 2.2,
    tip.length = 0.01
  )

  return(p)
}
```

# Correlation Analysis between C2-Sub1 score and CIBERSORT

```{r}

# BiocManager::install(c("curatedTCGAData", "MultiAssayExperiment", "TCGAutils", "GSVA"), update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)

# Load libraries
library(curatedTCGAData)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(singscore)

# From Fig. 6
CD4_EM_C2Sub1_vs_C3Sub2 <- qs2::qs_read("../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/breast cancer single-cell Map/CD4_EM_C2Sub1_vs_C3Sub2.qs2")

CD4_EM_C2Sub1_vs_C3Sub2_top_ups <- CD4_EM_C2Sub1_vs_C3Sub2 %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.585) %>% rownames()

CD4_EM_C2Sub1_vs_C3Sub2_top_downs <- CD4_EM_C2Sub1_vs_C3Sub2 %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC < -0.585) %>% dplyr::slice_min(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 20) %>% rownames()

#_______________

# Downloading TCGA-BRCA dataset (RNA-Seq normalized gene expression and clinical data)
brca_mae <- curatedTCGAData(diseaseCode = "BRCA",
                            version = "2.1.1",
                            assays = "RNASeq2GeneNorm",
                            dry.run = FALSE)

qs2::qs_save(object = brca_mae,
             file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/TCGA/brca_mae.qs2")

brca_mae <- qs2::qs_read("../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/TCGA/brca_mae.qs2")

# Extract the gene expression data (SummarizedExperiment)
exp_se <- experiments(brca_mae)[["BRCA_RNASeq2GeneNorm-20160128"]]
colnames(exp_se) <- gsub("-01$", "", colnames(exp_se))

# Extract clinical data
clinical_data <- colData(brca_mae)

# Prepare expression matrix
expr_mat <- assay(exp_se)

# Prepare gene sets list
cd4_em_nonNK_nonCD8_signature <- c("CD4", "CD40LG", "IL7R", "ITGB1", "ANXA1")
up_genes_plus <- intersect(c(CD4_EM_C2Sub1_vs_C3Sub2_top_ups, cd4_em_nonNK_nonCD8_signature), rownames(expr_mat)) %>% unique()

down_genes <- intersect(CD4_EM_C2Sub1_vs_C3Sub2_top_downs, rownames(expr_mat)) %>% unique()

length(up_genes_plus)
length(down_genes)

# Compute Singscore (combined up/down)
# Rank genes per sample
ranked_mat <- rankGenes(expr_mat)

# Compute scores
plus_scores <- simpleScore(
  ranked_mat,
  upSet = up_genes_plus,
  downSet = down_genes,
  centerScore = TRUE
)

# Extract combined score
gene_set_plus_score <- plus_scores$TotalScore
names(gene_set_plus_score) <- colnames(expr_mat)

# Prepare survival data
# In TCGA, overall survival (OS) is typically constructed from:
# - vital_status: 0 (Alive) or 1 (Dead)
# - days_to_last_followup: for censored (alive)
# - days_to_death: for events (dead)

# Create OS time (in days)
os_time <- ifelse(clinical_data$vital_status == 1, 
                  clinical_data$days_to_death, 
                  clinical_data$days_to_last_followup)

# Create OS event (1 = dead, 0 = censored)
os_event <- ifelse(clinical_data$vital_status == 1, 1, 0)

# Censoring the follow-up time to 10 years (120 months; 3600 days)
## We censor all the patients with over 10 years survival (i.e. we set their survival/vital status to 0 up until 10 years and set their days (days_to_last_followup to 3600))
os_time[which(clinical_data$days_to_death > 3600 | clinical_data$days_to_last_followup > 3600)] <- 3600
os_event[which(clinical_data$days_to_death > 3600 | clinical_data$days_to_last_followup > 3600)] <- 0

# Ensure sample names match between expression and clinical
common_samples <- intersect(names(gene_set_plus_score), rownames(clinical_data))
length(common_samples)

# Subset to common samples
gene_set_plus_score <- gene_set_plus_score[common_samples]
os_time <- os_time[match(common_samples, rownames(clinical_data))]
os_event <- os_event[match(common_samples, rownames(clinical_data))]

# Remove NA in survival data
valid_idx <- !is.na(os_time) & !is.na(os_event) & !is.na(gene_set_plus_score)
os_time <- os_time[valid_idx]
os_event <- os_event[valid_idx]
gene_set_plus_score <- gene_set_plus_score[valid_idx]

#__________________________

# CIBERSORTx

# Subsetting expr_mat for uploading to CIBERSORTx
expr_mat_flt <- expr_mat[,names(gene_set_plus_score)]

## Removing genes with NA values
expr_mat_flt <- expr_mat_flt[-which(is.na(rowSums(expr_mat_flt))),]
expr_mat_flt <- as.data.frame(expr_mat_flt)
expr_mat_flt <- rownames_to_column(expr_mat_flt, var = "Gene")
write_tsv(expr_mat_flt, "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/TCGA/expr_mat_flt.tsv")

score_df <-
data.frame(
    Sample=names(gene_set_plus_score),
    CD4EM_score=gene_set_plus_score
)

ciber <- read.csv(
    "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/TCGA/CIBERSORTx_Job2_Results.csv",
    row.names=1,
    check.names=FALSE
)

identical(rownames(ciber), score_df$Sample) # T

# Compute correlations

immune_cols <-
colnames(ciber)[
    !(colnames(ciber) %in%
        c("P.value","Correlation","RMSE", "P-value"))
]

cors <- lapply(immune_cols,function(cell){

    tmp <- cor.test(
        score_df$CD4EM_score,
        ciber[[cell]],
        method="spearman"
    )

    data.frame(
        Cell=cell,
        rho=tmp$estimate,
        p=tmp$p.value
    )
})  %>% bind_rows()

## Vis CIBERSORT results

ciber_cors_vis <- 
  ggplot(cors, aes(x = "CD4 EM signature", y = reorder(Cell, rho), fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
  theme_classic()

```

```{r}
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(filename = "../../../Testing results/Supplementary Figure 24.pdf",
```
